description: This file defines the OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid class and its subclass Light, responsible for creating overlay data (such as colors) for Android components within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes methods for fetching theme-based colors and handling invalid data cases.

classes.name: OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating overlay data based on Android component themes.

classes.name: InvalidOverlayData
classes.description: A subclass of OverlayDataImpl representing invalid or failed overlay data.

classes.name: Light
classes.description: A subclass of OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid providing a light theme variant for overlay data.

methods.name: OverlyDataCreatorForAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a local context.

methods.name: createOverlayData
methods.description: Creates overlay data for a given remote app component, fetching theme colors.

methods.name: fetchRemoteColors
methods.description: Fetches and sets color attributes from the theme.

methods.name: getColorFromThemeAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a color from theme attributes, with a default fallback.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Indicates whether the overlay data is valid; overridden in InvalidOverlayData.

methods.name: Light
methods.description: Subclass providing a light theme overlay data configuration.

methods.name: fetchRemoteColors
methods.description: Overrides to set specific colors for the light theme.
